title: Restriction from the whole scheme commutes with cohomology pullback
statement: Let g:Y→X be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], W an open of X, G an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and q≥0. Let P_W be pullback along g restricted to W, followed by the coefficient identification (upperStarComp(g_W,j_W))^{-1} followed by upperStarComp(j_W_prime,g) [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback, lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then for every x in H^q(X,G), restriction to g^{-1}W of g^*(x) equals P_W of restriction to W of x. This includes W empty, W=X, and the identity morphism. The module also abbreviates the explicitly prescribed restriction and restricted-pullback maps; it introduces no new cohomology notion.

source.place: Tag 01F7, functoriality of cohomology; agent-written composition and restriction consequence.

proof.text: Apply composition functoriality to (g restricted to W) followed by W.ι, with named composite (g^{-1}W).ι ≫ g. Apply it also to (g^{-1}W).ι followed by g. The restriction identity makes the two named composites equal.

Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply identifies H^q of the composite coefficient morphisms with the composite H^q maps. The inverse comparison cancels its hom comparison since upperStarComp is an isomorphism. Apply the remaining H^q comparison to the cancellation equality; this gives the claimed square. The Lean calc explicitly writes these equalities, without any connecting map or cover assumption.
